headline: Gulf Equity Bourses Close Mixed as Strait of Hormuz Security Risks Persist
summary: Stock markets in the Gulf ended mixed as regional investors weighed tanker mine incidents near the Strait of Hormuz against diplomatic efforts to preserve maritime security.
why: Middle Eastern exchanges host energy majors and logistics companies highly sensitive to regional maritime stability.

impacts.name: DFM General Index
impacts.why: Stock markets in the region closed mixed amid lingering security concerns.
